Name: Dynamic Monsters - Scaling Difficulty and Elite Enemies
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][left]Thanks RandomCharacter23's idea from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39891?tab=posts]Monster Valley - Random Monster Ambush[/url]! I didn't end up implementing that idea to that mod, as it will be limited use, instead made it works for all monsters in Stardew Plus brings in additional ideas like Elite monster, increased spawn chance to make it more fun!﻿[/left][/center][center][size=5][b]
Dynamic Monsters

[/b][/size][/center][center][size=4]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]


[b]Dynamic Monsters[/b] breathes new life into Stardew Valley combat by making enemies grow stronger alongside you. As your Combat Level increases, monsters gain health, damage, ensuring the mines remain a challenge from Day 1 to Year 10.



[color=#ffff00][size=3]Something super funny at the end, unexpected 😂 Literally made my day as I was making this

For Demo purpose, I maxed all stat of monsters, and they are looking bigger bc they are all elite monster now.. spawn chance 100%

Default setting is much lighter like 3% scaling, you can config.

[/size][/color][center][youtube]tpvDx41T8lM[/youtube]﻿[/center]


[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[b]Level-Based Scaling[/b]
[list]
[*]Monsters automatically gain increased Max Health, Damage based on your player's Combat Level.
[*]By default, stats increase by 5% per level. At Combat Level 10, monsters are 50% stronger!
[*]Fully configurable math: make the game as subtle or as brutal as you like.
[/list][b]Elite Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*]There is a rare chance (configurable) for any monster to spawn as an [b]Elite[/b].
[*]Elite monsters are larger, and possess significantly higher stats than standard enemies.
[*]These serve as mini-bosses to keep you on your toes.
[/list][b]Dynamic Spawning[/b]
[list]
[*]Optional Feature: Increase monster density based on your level.
[*]Higher combat levels increase the chance for monsters to "clone" themselves upon spawning, creating larger swarms to fight through.
[/list][b]Location Control[/b]
[list]
[*]You have full control over where this mod is active.
[*]Toggle on/off specifically for: The Mines, Skull Cavern (Skeleton Cave), Volcano Dungeon, and Wilderness (Farm/Forest).
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
This mod includes full support for Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). You can adjust everything in-game without restarting:

[list]
[*]Stat multipliers per level.
[*]Elite spawn chance and strength.
[*]Extra spawn rates.
[*]Active locations.
[*]Debug Mode: Toggle this on to see exact HP, Damage values floating above every monster's head to verify the scaling.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41463/41463-1768867404-1099557515.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly Recommended for configuration)
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
